summary: Chapter 9 chunk 1, 36 units. Conjecture rule applied: damaged unrestorable words (u6, u9, u11) now say 'unclear' and keep the guess in flag/note (later glossary rule; the older line-27 rule is superseded); ordinary one-letter emendations keep 'on a conjectural reading' in both languages. Checked Devanagari: u4 kṛṣṇaiti is hiatus (flag removed); u24 bhruṇī is regular neuter dual (two flags removed); u13/u28 are sandhi ambiguities not typos; u29 gaṃḍe- needed a flag. Colour terms checked, nothing added except fixes in u24 ('widely','tightly','such as'). Identifications fine: padma, haridrā, jambū, nakula, meḍhra, vṛṣaṇa standard; indranīla and kumārikā hedged; vaidūrya disputed. Human decisions: u7, u24 viśrānta/jihve, u26 lips, u28 visarpiṇī, u29-30, u13 śuddhā/aśuddhā.
glossary_suggestions: Damaged unrestorable words: translation 'unclear' (naming the printed word), guess only in flag and note; supersedes glossary line 27 and the p02 ch05 k2 practice (p02 ch09 u6, u9, u11).
bhruṇī/-bhruṇī is the regular neuter dual of shortened -bhru; no flag.
Hindi nakula = नकुल यानी नेवला, kapota = कपोत यानी कबूतर, meḍhra = मेढ्र यानी पुरुष-लिंग, vṛṣaṇa = वृषण यानी अण्डकोष, hanu = हनु यानी जबड़ा.
snigdhāśuddhā / stabdhāsuptā type strings are sandhi ambiguities (split choice), not typo flags.
ati-unmiṣita / ati-nimiṣita = excessively open / shut (no 'widely', 'tightly'); -ādi = 'and the like', not 'such as'.
